english.title: Use / cause / permit use of vehicle likely to cause danger / nuisance at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:

(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(2) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
use / cause / permit use of a vehicle
at a location to which the road traffic enactments do not apply
at Stansted Airport London
in such a way as to cause / be likely to cause
danger / nuisance to a person.

english.notes: This Byelaw applies to any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
